summary: This clinical trial is testing a combination of diabetes medications called Met/SGLT-2i/GLP-1RA compared to other oral diabetes drugs in adults with type 2 diabetes. Type 2 diabetes is a long-term condition where the body does not use insulin properly, leading to high blood sugar levels. Researchers want to see how well these treatments work in participants who currently have poorly controlled blood sugar. The study is currently recruiting 430 people.
